bullets.text: Under supervision, wrote Python functions to parse provided company report records and tested transformations on hand-checked input examples using unittest.
Ran supplied NLTK tokenization and frequency-count steps on provided document samples, then inspected frequent terms with guidance using the topic-coding guide.
Under supervision, joined document identifiers to reporting metadata using SQL, checked unmatched records, visualized group comparisons, and documented missing-data handling.
As part of supervised research, implemented reusable Python modules for the product review workflow and wrote pytest regression tests for malformed and edge-case inputs.

Under supervision, compared dictionary coding with nonnegative-matrix-factorization topic exploration using scikit-learn, examined topic stability across repeated fits, and inspected product review documents supporting each interpretation.
Under supervision, joined review document identifiers to metadata using SQL and checked unmatched records, then visualized group comparisons and documented missing-data handling.
